title: A general paracontrolled ansatz for singular SPDEs
summary: We provide a general ansatz for the paracontrolled approach introduced by Gubinelli, Imkeller, Perkowski for treating singular SPDEs. The ansatz proposed covers a large class of equations. It is described via decorated trees that encode its coefficients and its stochastic data. The main novelty is the recursive definition of the paracontrolled stochastic iterated integrals that involve a well-chosen combinatorial set of words.
